name: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B

outline.source: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd)

pcb.source: typical 4-layer FR4 board thickness; not dimensioned on the mechanical drawing

mounting_holes.source: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B mechanical drawing (Raspberry Pi Ltd)

connectors.name: USB-C power input
connectors.source: port centre x = 11.2 mm from the board's left edge as drawn; body size from the receptacle datasheet
connectors.note: centre position consistent across published Pi 4 enclosure designs; verify against the drawing before promoting to datasheet

connectors.name: micro-HDMI 0
connectors.source: port centre x = 26.0 mm as drawn; shell size from the receptacle datasheet

connectors.name: micro-HDMI 1
connectors.source: port centre x = 39.5 mm as drawn; shell size from the receptacle datasheet

connectors.name: 3.5 mm audio / composite jack
connectors.source: jack centre x = 53.5 mm as drawn; barrel 6 mm, housing about 7 x 6 mm

connectors.name: Gigabit Ethernet (RJ45)
connectors.source: RJ45 jack about 16 x 13.5 mm, centre y = 45.75 mm from the bottom edge (Pi 4 moved Ethernet to the top of the connector end)
connectors.note: verify against the drawing; mirror y if the drawing shows Ethernet at the bottom

connectors.name: USB 3.0 stacked pair (blue)
connectors.source: double USB-A stack about 13.1 x 15.6 mm, centre y = 27.0 mm

connectors.name: USB 2.0 stacked pair (black)
connectors.source: double USB-A stack about 13.1 x 15.6 mm, centre y = 9.0 mm

connectors.name: microSD card slot (underside)
connectors.source: socket on the underside of the board centred on the short edge; inserted card protrudes about 2.5 mm
connectors.note: card slot width and protrusion are approximate

connectors.name: 40-pin GPIO header
connectors.source: 2 x 20 header, 2.54 mm pitch, centred on y = 52.5 mm; 8.5 mm above the PCB top
connectors.note: no wall opening; the lid must clear it (keepout only)

omitted: CSI and DSI ribbon connectors (internal, no wall opening; add when measured from a STEP file)

step_cross_check.source: community STEP 'Raspberry Pi 4 Model B v4.step' (multigamesystem/MGS-CAD-Files, licence unspecified, accuracy unverified)
step_cross_check.result: RECORDED ONLY, no value above was changed: outline 85 x 56, corner radius 3.0 and the 58 x 49 hole pattern at (3.5, 3.5) agree exactly with the official drawing; connector centres agree within 0.2 mm (the audio jack within 0.5 mm); the community model reaches 1 to 2 mm further past the edges than the drawing-based boxes
discrepancies: pcb thickness: 1.6 in the model vs 1.4 assumed here (not on the drawing)
mounting hole diameter: 6.0 in the model (it models the pad) vs 2.75 hole / 6.2 pad here

bounding box of the whole model 88.99 x 58.4 x 19.9 mm; connector overhang past the PCB: USB-C 1.5, micro-HDMI 1.8, audio 2.4, USB 2.0 stack 3.99, USB 3.0 stack 3.6, Ethernet 3.25 mm (boxes here: 0.5 to 2.0 mm)
usb3_pair / usb2_pair width: 15.7 / 15.3 mm in the model vs 13.1 here; top z 17.8 / 17.3 vs 17.0
ethernet: y 37.65..53.85 vs 37.75..53.75 (agrees); z top 15.1 vs 14.9 (solder tabs reach z -2.1)
audio: x 50.5..57.5 vs 50..57 (centre 54.0 vs 53.5), top z 7.6 vs 7.4; hdmi: x within 0.1 mm, z 1.06..4.57 vs 1.4..4.5; usb_c: x within 0.04 mm
